meta.title: Lao Ou Writing Workbench
meta.description: Nine-stage WeChat writing pipeline: find a topic (screen raw material for writable subjects) → pin the angle (choose the cut for a chosen subject) → structure → polish → spread optimization → self-check → title & cover copy → cover image, plus one-click run-the-rest. Compose a prompt and send it into a session; the same prompts are registered as 9 agent skills.
